# blender-hardsurface-modeling

Hard-surface and prop modeling in Blender 5.2 LTS+: blockout-to-detail flow, non-destructive modifier stacks (Mirror, Boolean Exact/Manifold, Bevel, Weighted Normal, Smooth by Angle), mid-poly vs subdivision vs high-to-low workflows, shading and custom normals, cylinder segment budgets, and edge attributes from Python, with a helper script that builds the stack inside Blender.
